plan:
PLAN: add refresh-token rotation

## Context
Adds automatic refresh-token rotation to the auth flow, invalidating the previous refresh token on each use (SYM-001).

## Steps
1. Add `rotateRefreshToken()` to src/auth/tokenService.ts
2. Update src/auth/authController.ts to call rotateRefreshToken() on refresh
3. Add src/auth/refreshTokenStore.ts to persist token generations
4. Add src/auth/refreshToken.middleware.ts to reject reused tokens
5. Update src/api/routes/auth.routes.ts to wire the new middleware
6. Update src/config/authConfig.ts to add the rotation TTL setting

FORECAST-REFINE: dev-mono ~9k (6 files, not the 1-file default)

## Tests
- src/auth/tokenService.test.ts::rotateRefreshToken issues a new pair and invalidates the previous refresh token
- src/auth/refreshToken.middleware.test.ts::rejects a reused refresh token with 401

## Rollback
Revert the commit. No data migration and no sca-waivers.json entry are introduced by this plan, so a code revert alone restores prior behaviour.
